# ThaiCERT (Thailand Computer Emergency Response Team)

> Thailand's national Computer Emergency Response Team providing cybersecurity incident response, threat intelligence, and coordination services for national cyber defense.

ThaiCERT (ศูนย์ประสานการรักษาความมั่นคงปลอดภัยระบบคอมพิวเตอร์แห่งชาติ) operates under the National Cyber Security Agency (NCSA) to monitor, prevent, and respond to cyber threats affecting Thailand's critical infrastructure and digital ecosystem. The organization provides threat bulletins, vulnerability alerts, and coordinates incident response across government and private sectors.

## Key Topics

- ThaiCERT - Thailand Computer Emergency Response Team
- Incident Response & Threat Intelligence
- Zero-Day Vulnerabilities & CVE Tracking

- Email Security & Gateway Protection

- Ransomware & LockBit
- WordPress Security

- International Cybersecurity Cooperation
- PGP Encryption & Secure Communications
- Monthly Cyber Threat Bulletins
- Critical Infrastructure Protection
